title: The Core of Data Quality & Governance

scenes.say: What makes data truly reliable? Can you actually trust the numbers in your pipeline?

scenes.label: Accuracy
scenes.say: One key dimension is accuracy. Does your data reflect real-world values, or is it off?
But accuracy is just one piece. Data quality covers completeness, consistency, timeliness, and uniqueness. Each checks a different risk.

scenes.title: dbt Uniqueness Test
scenes.say: Tools like dbt let you automate these checks. For example, a uniqueness test can flag duplicate records before they cause trouble.

scenes.label: Lineage
scenes.sub: Shows how data flows and transforms.
scenes.say: Data lineage maps how data flows and transforms, so you can trace issues back to the source.

scenes.question: Is PII just another column?
scenes.wrong: Yes, treat it like any field.
scenes.right: No, PII needs masking, encryption, and access controls.
scenes.say: Here's a common trap: Is personally identifiable information just another column? No way. PII needs masking, encryption, and strict access controls.
